'''EPHEMERIS''' droids was a series of multi-tasking droids used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. Combining the mathematical features of [[Class one droid/Legends|Class one droid]]s, administrative functions of [[Class three droid/Legends|Class three droid]]s and combat capabilities of [[Class four droid/Legends|Class four droid]]s, EPHEMERIS droids were used to run the [[Star Fortress]]es, a series of battlestation placed in orbit of multiple galactic worlds following the [[Eternal Empire conquest]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
EPHEMERIS droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during the Star Fortress series of missions.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
